blurb: Founded in 1916 to preserve all aspects of Wallingford's history, we have an ever-growing collection of Wallingford's cultural, military, agricultural, commercial, industrial and genealogical history, while serving as Wallingford's attic. Our main goals are to preserve and display our artifacts in order to educate people of all ages on the richness of the history of our ever-evolving 350-year-old town.
